message.content: The case concerns whether the stock manager can order jars against shipment G11. Claim A that the G11 pallet was wet on arrival is contradicted by a pallet inspection confirming it was dry. Claim B that six cartons arrived with G11 is strongly supported by the courier unloading receipt. Claim C that shipment G11 contained at least 96 saleable jars is moderately supported by the packing plan specifying 16 jars per carton and staff expectations, though jars were not individually counted or inspected. Given the confirmed arrival of six cartons and the packing plan, it is reasonable for the stock manager to order jars based on the shipment record despite the lack of direct jar inspection.
